description: This PHP test class 'PIMLeftMenuServiceTest' contains unit tests for the 'PIMLeftMenuService' in the OrangeHRM project. It verifies the behavior of menu item retrieval, cache management, and access permissions related to the PIM (Personal Information Management) module.

classes.name: PIMLeftMenuServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that tests the functionalities of the PIMLeftMenuService, including menu retrieval, caching, and access control.

methods.name: getAllMenuItems
methods.description: Mocks the getAvailableActions private method of PIMLeftMenuService to return available actions based on the tax menu enabled state.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsAllMenusAccessible
methods.description: Tests that all menu items are accessible when permissions are full and tax menu is disabled.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsOnlyDependentsAccessible
methods.description: Tests that only the dependents menu item is accessible when permission grants access solely to dependents.

methods.name: testClearCachedMenuOneEmployee
methods.description: Verifies that cached menu data for a specific employee is correctly cleared.

methods.name: testClearCachedMenuOneEmployeeNotCached
methods.description: Ensures that cache remains unchanged if no data is cached for the employee.

methods.name: testClearCachedMenuAll
methods.description: Checks that clearing cache for all employees resets the session cache to empty.

methods.name: testIsPimAccessibleTrue
methods.description: Confirms the PIM module is accessible when permissions are full and relevant features are enabled.

methods.name: testIsPimAccessibleFalse
methods.description: Validates that access to PIM is denied when permissions are completely false.
